title: The Last Orbit
author: Theo Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
